newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil pulled to higher close by Brent, heat.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil pulled to higher close by Brent, heat.

text.p: IPE gas oil closed higher on Thursday as a lower-than-expected physical Brent loading programme for April pulled the whole IPE complex higher, traders said.
April gas oil settled $1.75 higher at $169.25 a tonne having traded as high as $170.25 in early trade.
"The smaller Brent programme has helped the whole complex," one trader said.
The Brent programme for April was the equivalent of eight full 500,000 cargoes lower than in March, physical traders reported on Thursday.
April crude was trading 37 cents higher at $19.98 a barrel at 1801 GMT.

Players said strength in NYMEX heat due to bullish cold weather forecasts and an expected seasonal bounce which usually occurs when refiners stem distillate output to concentrate on gasoline for the summer, had also helped gas oil higher.
NYMEX heating oil was trading 0.72 cent higher at 54.80 cents a gallon. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
